tools.name: qt_documentation_read
tools.description: Read the full content of a specific Qt documentation page, or a single member of it with 'symbol'. Use the filename shown in search results.

tools.name: qt_documentation_search
tools.description: Call qt_documentation_search when: (a) you're about to claim a signal/slot/property/default exists, (b) the API is in Qt 6.7+ or a non-core module (MQTT, OPC UA, Network Auth, etc), (c) the user used the words 'docs', 'official', 'verify', or 'check'. Skip when: the question is about basic QString/Q

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "qt_documentation_read" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Read the full content of a specific Qt documentation page. Use the filename shown in search results." → after: "Read the full content of a specific Qt documentation page, or a single member of it with 'symbol'. Use the filename shown in search results."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
